description: This file contains helper methods for extracting specific tokens and IDs from web page HTML content in the context of functional tests for the eShopWeb project.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to parse HTML input and extract verification tokens and item IDs.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts the request verification token value from the input HTML string using regex.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts the item ID from the input HTML string using regex.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs a regex match on the input string and returns the last captured group.
